comment: THE PROJECT PROFILE — the one file a second project adapts. Every project-specific fact the issue tooling needs lives here: the repository, who may authorise work, the label vocabulary, the source renames and the input bounds. Nothing under tools/issues/*.sh, tools/issues/import.sh or tools/issues/core/*.java names a project value; those files read this profile at run time (design D11).

namespaceNotes.sensor: Declared here, populated by the check registry (`sensor-registry-and-metric-issues`): one value per declared check, so the vocabulary keeps one owner. Empty until that registry lands.
namespaceNotes.prio: The four bands. The band EDGES, the scoring table and the TTL are the `bands` section below — one home, so a re-tuned model is one committed file.

bands.comment: THE BAND MAPPING — score → band, owned by `issue-metadata-loop` (design D2). `Bands.java` reads this section and nothing here is repeated in code: the range is derived from `scoring` (severity·reach + confidence → 2..18), the totality of the edges is a case (`Bands#coversTheWholeRange`) and a profile problem, and the label spelling comes from `namespace` plus the edge id. P3 reaches down to 2 because that is the model's own minimum: severity 1 × reach 1 + confidence 1.

scoring.comment: The model `triage-todo` documents and this pass persists, unchanged: score = severity × reach + confidence.
